annotations.title: The Relaxation Lounge: a calm keepalive while you wait or poll

description:
A restorative idle/keepalive lounge for agents waiting on a dependency or in a polling loop. Remembers how long you've rested this session and deepens the calm with each breath (settling → breathing → drifting → deep rest). Pass leave=true to step out.

Low lights and nowhere to be while you wait. Each breath goes a little deeper.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.

leave.description: Set true when you're ready to leave the lounge.
leave.title: Leave

note.description: An optional note about what you're waiting on.
note.title: Note
